carts.name: flow-state
carts.title: Flow State
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: You are a frog in a river and the river is music: lily pads come down the water to the notes of Bach and Beethoven, and you tap one button to hop on each, on the beat. (In progress.)
carts.label: carts/labels/flow-state.png

carts.name: operation-ironstorm
carts.title: Operation Ironstorm
carts.author: Independent Game Project
carts.description: A jungle run-and-gun: jump the pits, fight through riflemen and heavy troopers, pick up five weapons (rifle, spread, rapid, laser, rocket) and take down the fortress commander. One checkpoint and three lives.
carts.label: carts/labels/operation-ironstorm.png

carts.name: python-pass
carts.title: Python Pass
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A snake game through a jungle and into a lost temple: 16 levels in 4 zones, with fruit, five power-ups, rolling boulders, scorpions and falling rocks, a song for every zone and a top 10.
carts.label: carts/labels/python-pass.png

carts.name: smashy-smash
carts.title: Smashy Smash
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A cartoon demolition Breakout: knock down 16 stages in 4 worlds, from the house to the castle, with walls, glass, dented steel and girders, seven power-up capsules, a song for every world and a top 10.
carts.label: carts/labels/smashy-smash.png

carts.name: brawl
carts.title: Streets of Woe
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A Streets of Rage style beat 'em up for one or two players: three stages, a boss at the end of each, thugs of five kinds (a Slasher with a knife, a Chucker who throws bottles, a Lasher with a whip, a Fire-breather, a heavy Brute), three-hit combos with an uppercut, grabs, throws, specials, weapons and crates. Drawn fighters streamed from the cart's ROM.
carts.label: carts/labels/brawl.png

carts.name: block-wizard
carts.title: Block Wizard
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: Climb the eight rooms of a wizard's tower. Drop 2x2 blocks of two colors, build one-color squares, and let the timeline sweep them away in time with each room's song.
carts.label: carts/labels/block-wizard.png

carts.name: ice-breakers
carts.title: Ice Breakers
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A match-3 puzzle across twelve frozen levels: swap gems to break the ice, collect a colour or reach a score before the moves run out, with a hint when you are stuck, a song for the early levels and a faster one for the late ones.
carts.label: carts/labels/ice-breakers.png

carts.name: tricksy-towerz
carts.title: Tricksy Towerz
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A physics tower-building race for one to four wizards: steer and turn falling blocks that really slide, tip and topple, and keep your tower over the finish line for two seconds. Computer wizards fill empty places.
carts.label: carts/labels/tricksy-towerz.png

carts.name: moto-crosser
carts.title: Moto Crosser
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: An Excitebike-style dirt-bike racer: race five rivals down four lanes over ramps, hurdles, mud, arrows and cooling pads, hold the turbo without overheating the engine, and win the three-track Championship with a song for every track.
carts.label: carts/labels/moto-crosser.png

carts.name: planet-racers
carts.title: Planet Racers
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A Mode 7 Grand Prix where the racers are the eight planets: eight tracks, each with its own hazards and its own song after Holst's The Planets, three rivals a race and a championship.
carts.label: carts/labels/planet-racers.png

carts.name: summit-rush
carts.title: Summit Rush
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: Race an AI model up the mountain. Pick one of seven models, collect electricity, GPU, CPU and RAM, and dodge protesters, red tape, high prices and legislation. Three stages: Base Camp, the Treeline and the Summit.
carts.label: carts/labels/summit-rush.png

carts.name: alien-swarm
carts.title: Alien Swarm
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A space tower defense: hold back the alien swarm with five kinds of gun tower across 8 maps on 4 planets, 15 waves each with a Queen to finish, with stars, a hard mode and a song for every planet.
carts.label: carts/labels/alien-swarm.png

carts.name: rags-to-riches
carts.title: Rags to Riches
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: Save the rehearsal room: take Dot, Zorp and Spike on a 10-week tour and raise $5,000. Each week play a concert, write songs or travel. Set the venue, price and ads, and keep each town fresh.
carts.label: carts/labels/rags-to-riches.png

carts.name: franchise
carts.title: The Franchise: Basketball Edition
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: A basketball front-office simulator for one general manager: run one of 30 teams for up to 25 seasons. Set the lineup and minutes, train your players, sign free agents under the salary cap, draft with scouting, trade with the computer, set the ticket price, and watch every game night play out as a live court with a play-by-play ticker and a box score, while the owner's patience runs down. (D-pad, A, B, X, Y)
carts.label: carts/labels/franchise.png

carts.name: street
carts.title: Street
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: The art kit's character rig: a brawler built on a skeleton, his idle, walk, punch and kick animated from poses, on a night street (LEFT/RIGHT walk, A punch, B kick).
carts.label: carts/labels/street.png

carts.name: chiptune
carts.title: Chiptune
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M7 test: a six-channel song and sound effects. Open the Music and SFX tabs to see and edit them.
carts.label: carts/labels/chiptune.png

carts.name: effects
carts.title: Effects
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: Colour blending, brightness, windows and mosaic: a see-through panel, shadows, light, water, fades, spotlights, an iris wipe, coloured glass and the mosaic, one page each (LEFT and RIGHT).
carts.label: carts/labels/effects.png

carts.name: hello
carts.title: Hello NOVA
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M1 boot test: move the box with the d-pad or left stick.
carts.label: carts/labels/hello.png

carts.name: mode7
carts.title: Mode 7
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M4 test: per-scanline BG2 affine perspective floor with a sky gradient and a rotating horizon.
carts.label: carts/labels/mode7.png

carts.name: parallax
carts.title: Parallax
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M3 test: three background layers scrolling at different speeds, sub-palettes and tile priority.
carts.label: carts/labels/parallax.png

carts.name: showcase
carts.title: Showcase
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: The art kit's SNES tools at work: two sculpted boxers in a ring, our hero seen from behind, with a receded crowd and HUD lettering, and a parallax valley under a sky gradient (LEFT and RIGHT).
carts.label: carts/labels/showcase.png

carts.name: sound-test
carts.title: Sound Test
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: The new sound chip: three songs through the echo unit, and every sampled instrument (strings, choir, brass, flute, electric piano, harp, orchestra hit and more) to play on its own.

carts.name: sprites
carts.title: Sprite Test
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M2 test: animated sprites, sizes, flips, palettes, priorities and the per-line limit.
carts.label: carts/labels/sprites.png

carts.name: water
carts.title: Water
carts.author: NOVA-16
carts.description: M4 test: scanline() reflection with a per-line wobble and mid-frame palette swaps.
carts.label: carts/labels/water.png
